nodes.label: Key Design Decisions
nodes.rationale: Substrate chosen over Solana for full pallet customization and civic sovereignty. RISC Zero chosen over circom for pure-Rust circuits with WASM prover. Blake3 over SHA-256 for speed and resistance to length-extension attacks. Reveal toggle is one-way by design to prevent retroactive voter intimidation.

nodes.label: Civic Truth Machine Concept
nodes.rationale: Not a social network but a minimal tamper-proof people-owned ledger of national opinion. Constraint is the feature: no feeds, no profiles, no clout — only structured signal.
